I can do that — but I need one detail before I proceed.

You said it's weekly but didn't say whether to remove just the occurrence next Tuesday or the whole recurring series. By "next Tuesday" I mean Tuesday, Sep 8, 2026 at 9:00 AM America/Los_Angeles. Which would you like me to delete?

- Delete only that single occurrence on Sep 8, 2026 at 9:00 AM (scope = one)
- Delete the entire weekly series (scope = series)

Also confirm you want it deleted (this is destructive and may send cancellations to attendees). Once you confirm scope and the delete action, I'll proceed.
